enabled.description: Enable passwdqc enforcement. If false, only logs weak passwords without blocking them.

min_length.description: Minimum lengths for passwords, encoded as 'disabled:class:min:length'. Format: disabled (off), weak (14 chars), medium (11), strong (6). Example: 'disabled:14:11:6'

max_length.description: Maximum password length in characters. Set to 0 for no upper limit.

similar.description: Minimum number of different character classes (upper, lower, digit, other) required in password. 0 = no requirement.

dictionary_path.description: Path to word list for dictionary-based rejection. Set to 'none' to disable.

reject_user_name.description: Reject passwords containing the user's login name or gecos (full name) fields.

unique_chars.description: Minimum number of unique characters required in the password. 0 = no requirement.

remember_count.description: Number of previous passwords to remember for history enforcement. Set to 0 to disable history.

old_passwords_path.description: Path to file storing hashed password history.

retry_limit.description: Maximum number of authentication attempts allowed before locking. 0 = no limit.

extra_options.description: Additional key=value pairs for advanced or optional passwdqc settings.

val.description: Value to assign to the keyword
